title: Part History layout stays stable and the status change is searchable
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. You hold the "Part Library & Inventory - Delete" permission (needed to change status/tracking).
  3. A part with a short status entry (e.g. "Deactivated") and other events in its history.
custom_steps:
1. Open Part History and confirm a short entry does not widen the Staff, Date or Time columns (Event takes the remaining width).
  2. Confirm the status change shows the same Staff/Date/Time columns as any other event and is found by the Part History search.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Part History table keeps the same column layout whatever an entry says (a short "Deactivated" does not widen Staff/Date/Time; Event takes the remaining width).
  • A status change appears with the same Staff, Date and Time columns as every other event and is searchable from the Part History search.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 10 (Confirming & recording a status change); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.
